name: CatSynth adaptive open-world candidate pool v2
protocol_revision: The candidate source, hash, order, promotion rule, and publication gate are unchanged from v1. V2 restores the previously established twelve-repair safety budget, permits ordinary pure Python map/filter built-ins in generated code, sends one shared breed catalog per repair request instead of duplicating it inside every failure, and surfaces terminal provider errors. V1 stopped at replay-all epoch 7 after a NameError from the omitted map built-in, one genuine regression attempt, and four usageLimitExceeded errors that the adapter had misreported as empty completions.
promotion_rule: Probe candidates once in listed order against the retained Sketch-CE incumbent plus the cumulative promoted corpus. Promote exactly those whose checked fields fail. Never send a passing coverage probe to the Developer.
control_rule: After discovery closes, replay the exact promoted stream and evolved sketch checkpoints through both rebuild controls without exposing rejected candidates.
stop_rule: Complete the pool unless an arm exceeds twelve Developer repair calls for one promoted epoch or the harness detects leakage, fixture-specific code, model fallback, or a malformed artifact.
publication_gate: Treat the result as a useful counterexample comparison only if at least five candidates are genuinely promoted and every arm reaches the full cumulative visible gate. Hidden cases remain evaluation-only.
